items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did the Morgan band, the Sam and Isaiah both, did they use music ever much or did they mostly just ear players? [INTERVIEWEE] Mostly, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, the first job I played with a band. I, Zeldon Morgan, was playing over at the Artesian Hall one night and the client up there, Adolfo was playing over at the Artesian Hall one night and the first one night was playing with him. For some reason he couldn't so he asked me to go over there. He sent me over there. That was my first job with a band. And well I, I was pretty fair there. Just playing by ear, you know.
Did the Morgan band, the Sam and Isaiah both, did they use music ever much or did they mostly just ear players?
Mostly, yeah. They, they, they, they'd get to, they'd get the music of a number and run over until they get it in the head and then put it aside.
